text:
maia: quick heads-up: emerald-ptq-v2 canary started returning broken JSON across stream chunks for tool calls. example raw pieces below.

maia: ```json
{"action":"create_issue","params":{"title":"deploy fail","tags":["infra",}
```

maia: ```json
,"severity":"high"}}
```

oliver: ouch. looks like chunk boundary left a trailing comma. did this begin after the latest PTQ flags or after the kvcache streaming change?

maia: correlated with the PTQ rollout + kvcache streaming enabled. repro uses long prompt + stream=true + max_tokens=2048.

shreya: is our stitcher doing any normalization? we currently try to drop leading commas and wait-for-close. if the comma lands inside a split it misrepairs.

vik: suggestion: run a json5-like lenient repair pass before forcing a full retry. cheaper but we must mark repaired outputs in telemetry.

maia: local json5 patch healed ~70% of samples but mutated structures in a few cases (arrays merged). plan: flag repaired outputs, do not auto-accept for sensitive routes, and add high-sample raw-stream logging.

shreya: I'll add a sampler capturing variant, quant config, kvcache flag, prompt length, and raw token boundary snapshots. canary id: emerald-ptq-v2-2026-03-20.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: reverted emerald-ptq-v2 to emerald-ptq-v1 at 5812345682 to preserve stability.

maia: I'll run matrix kvcache on/off x streaming on/off x quant-opset and post results tomorrow.

vik: cc platform-team: quarantine PTQ builds until stitcher and router non-destructive repair flag landed.
